name: Synthwave
blurb: The 1980s as remembered: big snares, pulsing bass and brassy leads.

sounds.name: Brass lead
sounds.why: A synth pretending to be a horn section. The filter opens a moment after each note starts, the way a brass player swells into a note.

ingredients.name: One sawtooth
ingredients.adds: A bright, flat lead.

ingredients.name: Three saws
ingredients.adds: Three slightly detuned saws per note.

ingredients.name: Swell the filter
ingredients.adds: Each note starts dull and opens up.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.below: The start of each note is missing.

ingredients.name: Vibrato
ingredients.adds: A slight wobble in pitch on every note.

ingredients.name: Reverb and echo
ingredients.adds: A big, glossy 80s studio.

knobs.above: The melody trips over its own echoes.

sounds.name: Drums with a gated snare
sounds.why: The 80s snare: a huge burst of reverb that stops almost at once. Strudel has no true gate, so this uses a very loud, very short room.

ingredients.name: Snare on 2 and 4
ingredients.adds: A plain backbeat from the default kit.

ingredients.name: The LinnDrum
ingredients.adds: The drum machine on half the pop records of 1983.

ingredients.name: A lot of reverb
ingredients.adds: Far more than sounds natural.

ingredients.name: But a short one
ingredients.adds: A small room, so the burst ends quickly.

knobs.label: room size
knobs.above: The tail runs over the next kick: big, but not gated.

ingredients.name: Kick on 1 and 3
ingredients.adds: The other half of the beat.

ingredients.name: Hats
ingredients.adds: Steady eighth-note hats.

sounds.name: Octave bass
sounds.why: Eighth notes bouncing between a low note and the same note an octave up. It drives the track the way a rhythm guitar would.

ingredients.name: One sawtooth
ingredients.adds: The same bass note eight times a bar.

ingredients.name: Bounce an octave
ingredients.adds: Every second note is an octave higher.

ingredients.name: Pluck the filter
ingredients.adds: Each note starts bright and closes.

ingredients.name: Short notes
ingredients.adds: A gap between each note.

ingredients.name: Follow the chords
ingredients.adds: The bass moves to a new note each bar.
ingredients.listenFor: Now there is a song under the lead.

sounds.why: Wide, slow chords under everything: the "sunset" in the sound.

sounds.name: Synth chords
sounds.why: The same chords as the pad, played short in a pushed rhythm, like a rhythm guitar part on a keyboard.

sounds.name: Electronic tom fill
sounds.why: Simmons electronic toms falling in pitch: "doo doo doo doom". The sound of the last bar before every 80s chorus.

ingredients.name: Toms on the last beat
ingredients.adds: High, high, mid, low.

ingredients.name: Simmons toms
ingredients.adds: Electronic drums whose pitch falls as they ring.

ingredients.name: Only every fourth bar
ingredients.adds: Silent for three bars, then the fill.

ingredients.name: The same big room
ingredients.adds: Matches the snare.

knobs.label: reverb
knobs.below: Small and dry next to the snare.
